newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ALBANIA, March 11 - Durres - Six vessels in port operating, all discharging, of which 1 nitrates, 2 bagged wheat flour, 3 general cargo. 6 Vessels in roads awaiting berths, all to discharge, of which 1 bagged rice, 2 bagged cement, 1 bulk cement, 1 bulk coal, 1 bricks.

BULGARIA, March 10 - Varna - Varna east, Varna west, Balchik - 39 Vessels in port operating of which 23 loading (1 soda,fertiliser, 1 cement, 5 soda, 1 frozen chicken/matchboxes, 1 edc, 3 quartz sand, 2 sas, 1 ply-wood, 3 clinker, 1 sulphuric acid, 1 cigarettes, 1 urea, 1 kaolin, 1 tsp). 3 Discharging (1 copper concentrates, 1 coal, 1 phosphorite). 3 Discharging/loading trucks/containers, 10 discharging/loading containers. 10 Vessels waiting in roads of which 3 to load (1 cement, 1 sas, 1 soda), 5 cargo not nominated, 2 to discharge/load containers.

Bourgas - 13 Vessels in port operating of which 9 loading (4 fertiliser, 1 general cargo, 1 timber, 3 steel). 1 Discharging sugar, 2 discharging/loading (1 cars, 1 sugar/metals), 1 empty vessel. 10 Vessels waiting in roads of which 2 to load (1 chemicals, 1 vegetable oil). 1 To discharge tobacco, 2 to discharge/load (1 magnetite/fertiliser, 1 general cargo,metals), 1 to discharge/load cars. 2 Empty vessels, 2 awaiting orders. 20 Vessels due of which 9 to load (1 steel, 1 coils/plate, 1 copper, 3 fertiliser, 1 copper, 1 bentonite, 1 cotton/corn). 7 To discharge (1 lead concentrate, 1 copper, 1 metals, 1 wheat, 1 lead/zinc, 1 coal, 1 rails). 3 To load/discharge containers, 1 to load/discharge metals/containers.

March - Varna - No strikes. Varna east - 5 Vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 2 awaiting orders. Varna west - 8 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load. Varna lesport/tanker port - No vessels. Bourgas - No strikes. Bourgas east - 9 Vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 8 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 under repair/dry-docked, 17 due. Bourgas west - 5 Vessels loading at berth. Tanker port - No vessels.

CROATIA, March 10 - Rijeka - Three vessels discharging at berth, 5 loading at berth, 6 under repair/dry-docked, 5 due. Split - One vessel discharging at berth, 1 under repair/dry-docked. Ploce - One vessel discharging at berth. Pula, Rasa, Zadar, Sibenik, Dubrovnik - No vessels.

CYPRUS, March 11 - Limassol - Six container vessels loading/discharging at berth, 7 conventional vessels discharging at berth. 7 Vessels due 12/3 of which 2 containers, 2 conventional vessels, 3 passenger vessels, no delays expected. Larnaca - One container vessel loading/discharging at berth, 2 conventional vessels discharging at berth. 3 Vessels due 12/3 of which 1 containers, 2 conventional vessels.

ESTONIA, March 11 - No labour problems. Tallinn - City port - 1 MAP vessel loading at berth, 1 liner, 7 vessels due. Kopli - 1 Meat, 1 flour vessel discharging at berth, 5 vessels due. Muuga - Four vessels loading at berth (1 timber, 2 containers, 1 fuel oil). 7 Discharging at berth (2 benzene, 1 fertiliser, 1 paper, 1 cocoa beans, 2 containers). Parnu - Port closed due to ice.

ITALY, March 11 - Naples - Two gas tanker, 1 etb 11/3, the other over the next few days. Gaeta - One general cargo vessel etb 12/3. Salerno - No vessels in roads. Genoa - Commercial port - 2 Vessels in roads, no delays, 35 vessels berthed, 5 dry-docked. Multedo - Oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays, no vessels berthed. Savona - No vessels in roads, no delays, 4 vessels berthed. Vado Ligure - No vessels in roads, no delays, 2 vessels berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays, 10 vessels berthed, 6 under repair/dry-docked. Leghorn - Eight vessels in roads, no delays, 44 vessels berthed. Civitavecchia - Two vessels in roads. Gaeta, Naples, Salerno, Palermo, Ancona, Falconara - No vessels in roads, no delays. Augusta - Oil harbour - 4 Vessels in roads, some delays, 2 berthed. Syracuse - Oil harbour - 2 Vessels in roads and expected to berth 12/3, no vessels berthed. Sarroch - Three vessels in roads, 4 berthed. Taranto - One vessel in roads. Ravenna - Eight vessels in roads. Venice - No vess

LATVIA, March 11 - No strikes at any port. Ventspils - Six vessels in port of which 4 operating as follows, 1 steel billets loader, 1 mop loader, 1 timber loader, 1 ferrous metal loader. 2 Vessels waiting, no delays, 11 due. Riga - 12 Vessels in port, all operating, of which 5 timber loaders, 2 container loaders, 2 steel loaders, 1 tanker loader, 2 frozen food dischargers. No vessels waiting, no delays, 20 due. Liepaja - 13 Vessels in port operating, no vessels waiting, no delays, 4 due.POLAND, March 11 - Szczecin - 35 Vessels loading at berth, 38 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 10 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 76 due. Gdynia - 14 Vessels operating of which 5 loading at berth (3 general cargo, 2 bulkers). 9 Discharging at berth (4 general cargo, 3 bulkers, 2 grain). 4 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 28 due. Gdansk - 12 Vessels operating of which 6 loading at berth (2 bulkers, 2 general cargo, 2 coal). 6 Discharging at berth (2 bulkers, 4 gener

PORTUGAL, March 10 - Setubal - Two vessels loading at berth, 8 discharging at berth, 6 under repair/dry-docked. 8 Vessels due of which 5 to discharge, 2 to load, 1 for repair/dry-dock. Leixoes - 11 Vessels operating of which 8 general cargo, 3 containers. No vessels waiting, vacant places, 5 piers with cranes, 2 without cranes. Sines - Three vessels in port operating of which 2 discharging crude oil, 1 loading unleaded gasoline/jet fuel. 2 Vessels waiting of which 1 to discharge crude oil, 1 to load fuel oil. 4 Vessels due of which 1 to discharge crude oil, 3 to load (1 propylene, 2 propane,butane). March 11 - Lisbon - 65 Vessels in port of which 14 discharging at berth, 5 loading/discharging, 1 loading at anchorage, 17 under repair/dry-docked, 7 awaiting orders, 21 miscellaneous craft, 38 due.

ROMANIA, March 10 - Constanta - 29 Vessels in port operating of which 11 general cargo (10 loading, 1 discharging), 7 bulkers (3 loading, 4 discharging), 6 bagged chemicals, 3 tankers, 2 bagged cement (all loading). 8 Vessels waiting in roads of which 5 bulkers (3 to load, 2 to discharge), 2 tankers to discharge, 1 general cargo to load. Constanta south (Agigea) - 6 General cargo vessels loading. Mangalia - No vessels operating. Midia - Six livestock carriers loading.

RUSSIA - FAR EASTERN PORTS - March 11 - No delays/strikes/congestion. Vladivostok - 15 Vessels in port of which 9 loading (6 metal, 1 timber, 2 general cargo). 2 Discharging (1 coke, 1 refrigerators), 4 waiting. Nakhodka - 14 Vessels in port of which 9 loading (2 metal, 5 timber, 1 general cargo, 1 aluminium), 5 waiting. Vostochny - 11 Vessels in port of which 5 loading (4 timber, 1 metal). 2 Containers discharging/loading, 1 discharging cars, 3 waiting. Posyet - One vessel in port loading metal. Zarubino - No vessels.

BALTIC PORTS - St. Petersburg - March 10 - 20 Vessels in port operating of which 15 loading (8 non-ferrous metals, 2 fertiliser, 2 containers, 1 cellulose, 1 coal, 1 general cargo). 5 Discharging (2 milk products, 2 containers, 1 general cargo). 9 Vessels waiting, 14 due. March 11 - No strikes. Kaliningrad - 12 Vessels in port, all operating, of which 1 urea loader, 1 ferrous metal loader, 5 aluminium loaders, 1 timber loader, 1 scrap metal loader, 1 meal discharger, 1 fruit discharger, 1 animal fodder discharger. No vessels waiting, no delays, none due. Vyborg - Four vessels in port, all operating, no vessels waiting, no delays, 3 vessels due.

BLACK SEA - Novorossiysk - March 3-9 - 18 Vessels in port operating of which 14 loading (2 scrap, 4 steel, 1 steel/paper, 1 copper cathodes, 1 fertiliser, 1 cars). 4 Discharging (2 various, 1 rice, 1 bulk sugar). 21 Vessels waiting in roads of which 10 to load (1 scrap, 2 steel, 1 steel/tin, 1 tin, 1 copper cathodes, 1 aluminium, 1 cattle, 1 cellulose, 1 vegetable oil). 10 To discharge (4 bulk sugar, 2 bagged rice, 1 rice, 2 citrus, 1 pipes/containers), 1 to discharge containers. 34 Vessels due of which 23 to load (1 bulk cement, 3 scrap, 7 steel, 1 copper, 1 copper cathodes, 2 aluminium, 1 tin, 1 pig-iron, 1 barley, 1 bulk urea, 1 coal, 2 seeds, 1 paper). 11 To discharge (1 bulk sugar, 2 rice, 4 citrus, 1 equipment, 1 barytes, 1 zinc concentrates, 1 containers). Oil termial operations 11/3 - No vessels berthed, 3 tankers waiting in roads of which 1 to load diesel oil, 2 fuel oil. 8 Tankers due to load (7 crude oil, 1 diesel oil).

NORTHERN BASIN - Murmansk - March 11 - Five vessels operating of which 3 alumina, 1 npk, 1 apatite, 3 apatite loaders, 2 alumina dis-chargers awaiting berths. 6 Vessels due during the week of which 3 loaders (1 non-ferrous metals, 1 steel, 1 cabotage), 3 dischargers (2 alumina, 1 grain).

UKRAINE, March 10 - Mariupol - Seven vessels in port operating of which 6 loading (1 sunflower seeds, 2 fertiliser, 3 steel). 1 To discharge equipment. 7 Vessels waiting in roads of which 6 to load (3 steel, 2 fertiliser, 1 sun flower seeds). 1 To discharge/load containers. 16 Vessels due of which 6 to load (2 fertiliser, 1 coal/coke, 1 fire-clay, 2 steel). 2 To discharge (1 chrome ore, 1 polyethylene). 2 To discharge/load (1 equipment/slabs, 1 containers/metal products). 6 To discharge/load containers.

Odessa - 15 Vessels in port operating of which 7 loading (1 chemicals, 2 metal, 1 paper, 1 barley, 1 sunflower seeds, 1 fuel oil). 2 Discharging citrus, 4 under repair, 2 passenger vessels. 17 Vessels waiting in roads of which 9 to load (3 sunflower seeds, 2 metals, 1 fertiliser, 1 steel, 2 oil). 4 To discharge gasoil, 3 waiting, 1 under arrest. 16 Vessels due of which 7 to load (4 metals, 1 diesel oil, 2 sunflower seeds). 6 To discharge (1 gasoil, 2 bananas, 3 citrus). 2 To discharge/load containers, 1 passenger vessel.

March 11 - Mariupol - Seven vessels loading at berth (1 sunflower seeds, 1 fertiliser, 1 sulphur, 4 metal products). 3 Discharging at berth (1 general cargo, 1 chrome ore, 1 pvc), 1 vessel under repair/dry-docked. 6 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load (2 metal products, 1 sulphur, 1 fertiliser, 1 sunflower seeds, 1 containers). 12 Floating storehouses (1 sulphur, 10 fertiliser, 1 metal products). 17 Vessels due by 5/4 of which 10 to load (3 metal products, 3 sulphur, 1 fertiliser, 1 coal, 1 clay, 1 containers). 5 To discharge containers, 2 to discharge general cargo/load metal products.

Kerch - Five vessels under repair/dry-docked, 3 due of which 2 to load metal products, 1 to discharge general cargo. Berdyansk - Two vessels loading at berth (both sunflower seeds). 1 Vessel waiting at anchorage to load metal products, 2 vessels due by 12/3, both to load fertiliser. Odessa - Steel cargo loaders, 1 vessel berthed, 3 anchored, 4 due. Containers, 2 vessels due. Grain cargo loaders, 2 vessels berthed, 3 anchored, 2 due. Tanker loaders, 1 vessel berthed, 1 anchored, 1 due. Tanker dischargers, 1 vessel berthed, 3 anchored, 1 due. General cargo, 5 vessels berthed, 2 anchored, 2 due. Fertiliser, 1 vessel. Ilychevsk - Steel cargo loaders, 9 vessels berthed. General cargo, 1 vessel berthed.

YUGOSLAVIA, March 11 - Bar - 10 Vessels berthed of which 5 discharging (2 bananas, 2 containers, 1 wheat). 5 Loading (4 steel coils, 1 ingots). 5 Ferries on the lines Bar-Bari-Bar, Bar-Koper-Bar, no delays. Zelenika, Bijela - Two vessels under repair.
